UKMTO established suspicious activity 25 nautical miles northeast of Khasab, while professional reporting described a vessel fire, its subsiding and the crew’s safety. Five official products were issued: UKMTO warning No. 187-26, its 001 update, warning No. 186-26, update 185-26/001, and an update to JMIC bulletin No. 109 distributed via UKMTO.
